notes.title: VoxVR Update - Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
We finally added your most requested feature: layers!

You can read more details about this update on our blog.

Release 1.1.0 Changes

 Spectator UI: Now able to hide hands and avatar
 Spectrator UI: Now shows the framerate
 Copy & paste regions
 Create & edit multiple layers
 Rotate layers
 Added new environment: Factory

notes.title: VoxVR Now Available 🎉
notes.content:
You heard me right! VoxVR was finally released - and to celebrate the release we lowered the price for a short time!

VoxVR - The Virtual Reality Voxel Art Editor

VoxVR is a creative tool that allows you to create 3D models using cubes in virtual reality. Creating voxel art has never been more intuitive and easier! Stand in your own artwork while creating it or edit your existing creations by importing existing voxel files to view them from a whole new perspective. This software offers artists and gamers lots of fun by providing an entertaining and easy to use VR-workspace with a professional toolset.


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/502480/extras/Examples.png?t=1508346244


Features

 Features
 RGB and HSV color picker
 Color Palette and Pipette
 Different brushes
 Import of Magica Voxel (.vox) and Qubicle (.qb) files
 Import of .png images
 Import of pre-made color palettes
 Export to Magica Voxel (.vox) and Qubicle (.qb)
 Export of optimized meshes for game development and design in .obj, .dae and .stl (for 3D-printing) format
 Steam Workshop and Sketchfab integration
 Works with SteamVR and Oculus


Purchase now!
Purchase now on Steam!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/502480/VoxVR/

notes.title: VoxVR Update - Release 1.0.0
notes.content:
Hey fellows!

I'll start with a big announcement: VoxVR will release today at 8:00 AM PDT!

And now to the boring part:


Release 1.0.0 Changes

 added .mtl (material file) export to the .obj exporter
 made the Sketchfab exporter user interface look better
 improved lighting in Dome and Light environment
 improved Steam Workshop uploader performance
 improved VR SDK selection
 now trying to launch SteamVR when Oculus SDK was not found
 optimized the .vxvr file format
 example models are now uploaded to the steam workshop
 auto subscribe to example models (you can unsubscribe at any time)
 fixed a bug where the teleport pointer wouldn't go away

notes.title: VoxVR Update - Version 1.0.4 & Devblog #5
notes.content:
Preamble
Thanks to all our closed alpha testers! You've provided us with lots of feedback, and as you can see in the changelog below, we already implemented quite a few of your suggestions. Please fill in the form again after testing this update. Thank you!!
Lots of things have changed since the last update and we are now very close to release.

VoxVR Viewer - Announcement
VoxVR Viewer will release together with VoxVR as a separate application. VoxVR viewer allows you to view voxel models you have made with voxel-software like Magica Voxel, Qubicle or VoxVR in Virtual Reality. It's basically a lite version of VoxVR, which just doesn’t allow placing voxels. And I didn't mention the best part yet: It will be free.

Devblog #5
We wrote a new devblog - over there we are showing off and explain the latest changes. Read it here.

Version 1.0.4 Changes

     Added default color palette
     Added Magica Voxel palette importer (thx Gerald!)
     Added 'Clear Palette' button
     Added brush model previews to brush selection
     Added resolution dropdown to spectator UI
     Sketchfab auth-tokens are now saved
     Added file compression to .vxvr format
     Improved Steam Workshop integration (thumbnails)
     Improved render quality & enabled MSAA
     Improved preview color correctness
     Menu movement smoothing is now disabled by default
     Removed spectator camera VR input
     Fixed: Crash when closing VoxVR
     Fixed: Roll of spectator camera when switching modes
     Fixed: Paintbucket range of just 3 voxels
